articles.title: Asian shares are mixed as Brent crude approaches $100 a barrel - AP News
articles.description: Asian shares are mixed in cautious trading, as investors watch for what might happen on interest rates and the war with Iran pushes oil prices higher. Benchmarks rose Wednesday in Seoul, Shanghai and Taipei, but fell in Tokyo, Sydney, Hong Kong and Mumbai. U.…
